Subject: Coordinating QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling options

Hi Simon / Priya —

Hope you’re both well. As we approach your renewal next quarter, Marissa and I would like to run a 45–60 minute QBR that combines a short healthcheck, ROI review, and a focused roadmap demo showing the features we think will impact your token/unit economics.

Proposed slots (all US/PDT):
- Option A: Tue Sep 7 — 09:00–10:00
- Option B: Wed Sep 8 — 12:00–13:00
- Option C: Thu Sep 9 — 15:00–16:00

Please reply with the option that works best and list any internal stakeholders who should join (we’ve historically included Product, Platform, and the person who owns inference costs).

I’ve attached a draft agenda and a short list of suggested talking points — please review and flag anything you’d like moved or removed.

Attachments: HealthLytics_QBR_agenda_v0.3.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Coordinating QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling options

Thanks Jasmine —

Appreciate the agenda. Quick notes:
- Our CTO (Anika Rao) wants to sit in for the roadmap portion; she’s in India (IST +12:30 from PDT).
- Option B (Wed Sep 8 12:00–13:00 PDT) would be tough for our east coast team, but could work if we keep the core demo to 30 minutes and run the Q&A as a follow-up.
- Option C (Thu Sep 9 15:00 PDT) looks most promising for most attendees here.

Attendees: Simon Greene (Head of Platform), Priya Desai (VP Product), Anika Rao <anika.rao@healthlytics.com> (tentative).

Can you confirm whether you can record the demo and share slides in advance? We’ll also need a 1-pager covering expected cost delta for the proposed optimizations (batching + quantization).

—Simon

Subject: Re: Coordinating QBR + Roadmap demo — scheduling options

Simon — great, thanks for the heads up about Anika and the east-coast constraint. To make this painless I’ve sketched three specific windows and we can pick the one that maximizes live participation across teams. Please pick one option below (I’ll lock the invite once you confirm):

Option 1: Sep 9 — 09:30–10:30 PDT (works for US west / early IST if Anika can join late)
Option 2: Sep 9 — 12:00–13:00 PDT (best for US east + most HealthLytics attendees)
Option 3: Sep 10 — 08:00–09:00 PDT (compromise if we need a shorter live demo + on-demand recording)

Action items I’ll cover if we pick Option 2 (12:00–13:00 PDT):
- Marissa: lead the renewal framing and commercial ask (slides)
- Dylan: demo the roadmap items tied to cost savings and show latency/cost numbers live
- Rishi: prepare the 1-pager cost delta (batching + quantization) and add a slide to the deck

Marissa / Dylan / Rishi — can you confirm you’re good for Option 2 or flag conflicts?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite + Zoom once Simon confirms.

Jasmine
